model: int: electoral_votes; array[1..50] of float: electoral_coefficients; set of int: swing_states = {1, 2, 3, 4, 6}; array[swing_states] of var 0.0..1.0: swing_state_probabilities; var 0.0..1.0: total_probability = sum(i in swing_states)(swing_state_probabilities[i]); constraint forall(i in swing_states)(swing_state_probabilities[i] == electoral_coefficients[i]); constraint total_probability > 0.5; solve satisfy; output ["Total Probability: \(total_probability)\nSwing State Probabilities: \(array1d(swing_states, function(i) show(swing_state_probabilities[i])))"];
